subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should configured model costs remain USD-only, or should OpenClaw define a non-USD currency contract for local model-pricing estimates?
rationale: The request adds public config and changes cost display/accounting semantics across schema, status output, Control UI, docs, telemetry, and mixed-provider aggregation.

options.title: Design a currency contract first
options.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, and persisted-field semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep configured costs USD-only
options.body: Leave local `models.providers.*.models[].cost` estimates as USD and keep non-USD facts only in provider-reported billing surfaces.

options.title: Allow display-only override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol override while documenting that stored totals and telemetry remain USD-shaped estimates.

recommendation.title: Design a currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, and persisted-field semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision must coordinate with the recent provider billing and Usage UI boundary he authored.
